items.title: meteopavel.space
items.description: Personal portfolio hub built on a custom static site generator. Under the hood: Python + Jinja2 for HTML generation, CSV-driven shields generator with MD5 caching (skips API calls for unchanged data), CSS/JS minification pipeline, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Docker + Nginx. Includes a project passport generator for automatic API mapping across all infrastructure projects.

items.title: VOA Multi-domain Site
items.description: Website for a civic educational organization — collaboration ongoing since 2013. A single Django application serves multiple domains. Non-standard deployment: full Django stack with Nginx and MySQL running on shared hosting, bypassing its constraints — configured as on a dedicated server. CI/CD runs on a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner: GitHub's standard runners refused to work with the hosting environment.

items.title: Task Chronicle
items.description: CLI tool for generating monthly reports and exporting task context for LLM analysis. Pipeline: Redmine → normalization → chunks → summarization → monthly final analysis. Used in the monthly workflow: from raw Redmine data to NDA-safe portfolio summaries.

items.title: Home Router Panel
items.description: Web dashboard for managing a home Linux router/server. The server handles traffic obfuscation and split routing: different routing rules per destination. Management via FastAPI + Nginx. Non-standard CI/CD pipeline.
